prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a large two-storey hall or inn in a town built on terraces inside a volcanic crater. Dark red clay tile roof. Heavy dark basalt stone walls with red-orange accents and iron fittings. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 272 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached exact-layout guide into ONE finished standalone building sprite, keeping the exact same 1904×1568 canvas and pixel grid (272×224 art pixels at exactly 7×7 display pixels per art pixel). The attached magenta is TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, not a colour to render. Preserve guide geometry literally: rectangular roof footprint x=2..269 art pixels, y=28..133; visible roof is viewed from above, with horizontal roof-plane division/roof detail at y=75; vertical, straight-on front facade x=8..263, y=134..223. Keep roof/wall junction exactly at y=134. Roof is dark red clay tiles, with restrained tile rows, chunky coherent pixel clusters, eaves and iron fittings. Wall is substantial dark basalt masonry with burnt-red/orange accents and tidy architectural detailing: two-storey hall/inn in a volcanic crater town, premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art. Extremely important: preserve ALL seven glowing amber window openings at their EXACT guide footprints and placements: upper x44..59,100..115,154..169,210..225 at y148..167; lower x44..59,98..113,210..225 at y192..211. Preserve walk-through dark brown ground-level door EXACTLY x141..162 and y192..223, flat rectangular, reaching bottom image boundary, not a window, no stairs/steps blocking it. Window frames and subdivisions can be added INSIDE each original opening without moving its perimeter. No other doors/windows. Front face directly faces viewer, do not depict angled sidewalls or change silhouette. A modest chimney may protrude upward into transparent top margin; optional crates along wall must not obscure windows or door. Crisp identical square art pixels throughout, 7x7 raster display pixels each, no anti-aliasing, no smooth brushes, no noise, no dithering, no soft gradients, clusters of 3–10 art pixels, deliberate hue-shifted earthy palette (purple-red darks, warm ochre highlights), 4–6 solid colours per material. Clean soft neutral evenly lit base sprite, amber inside windows is the only emissive light; no cast shadows, no nighttime treatment or light pools. Fully transparent exterior, NO magenta, no ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
